37. 25-56956  Recommendation to request City Manager to return within 45 days with a late-night
  public safety plan for the Belmont Shore commercial corridor that:
  • Explores options for a temporary one-year moratorium on the operation of
  bars and alcohol-serving establishments in Belmont Shore after midnight;
  • Provides the feasibility and cost associated with re-establishing LBPD
  walking beats during high-traffic hours and re-activating the police sub-
  station in Belmont Shore;
  • Implements additional DUI enforcement in Belmont Shore at regular
  intervals aligned with peak egress times of bar patrons; and

  public drinking and unauthorized vendor operations.
